title: The Rotavirus Vaccine Story: From Discovery to the Eventual Control of Rotavirus Disease.
ehr_evidence: This is a narrative review/supplement article summarizing published literature on rotavirus vaccine discovery, development, and global impact; no primary individual-level data source was analyzed.
summary: Narrative review of the history of rotavirus vaccine discovery, development, licensure, and global implementation impact in children younger than 5 years.
limitations: Narrative review synthesizing cited literature without primary data analysis or quantitative synthesis
data_availability_statement: Supplementary materials are available at The Journal of Infectious Diseases online. Consisting of data provided by the authors to benefit the reader, the posted materials are not copyedited and are the sole responsibility of the authors, so questions or comments should be addressed to the corresponding author. The complete references are available as online Supplemental Material.
